title: Effective Adaptive Exploration of Prices and Promotions in Choice-Based Demand Models
authors: Lalit Jain; Zhaoqi Li; Erfan Loghmani; Blake Mason; Hema Yoganarasimhan
eligible_reason: Thompson-sampling algorithms for adaptive exploration of prices and promotions in multinomial choice models, evaluated in simulation environments (some calibrated to Nielsen parameters). No DiD or event-study design.
design_notes: main.py with configs/*.json runs the simulation experiments of Sections 5 and 7; generate_paper_plots.py makes the figures; params/nielsen_*.npy hold calibrated demand parameters.
data_files_note: Only calibrated parameters and model objects ship; no transaction data.
data_provenance_note: Simulation environments; Nielsen data used only for calibration and not shipped.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
